# 0A. Load packages and prepare an API output folder

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(hrbrthemes)

data_dir <- file.path("data", "governance-climate-finance")
dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```




```{r}
wgi_spec <- tribble(
  ~indicator_code, ~variable,
  "GOV_WGI_VA.SC", "voice_accountability",
  "GOV_WGI_PV.SC", "political_stability",
  "GOV_WGI_GE.SC", "government_effectiveness",
  "GOV_WGI_RQ.SC", "regulatory_quality",
  "GOV_WGI_RL.SC", "rule_of_law",
  "GOV_WGI_CC.SC", "control_of_corruption"
)

fetch_wgi <- function(indicator_code, variable) {
  api_url <- paste0(
    "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/",
    indicator_code,
    "?source=3&format=json&per_page=20000&date=2020:2024"
  )

  payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON(api_url, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)
  observations <- payload[[2]]

  tibble(
    iso3 = observations$countryiso3code,
    country = observations$country$value,
    year = as.integer(observations$date),
    variable = variable,
    value = as.numeric(observations$value)
  ) |>
    filter(str_length(iso3) == 3)
}

wgi_api_long <- map2_dfr(
  wgi_spec$indicator_code,
  wgi_spec$variable,
  fetch_wgi
)

wgi_api_2024 <- wgi_api_long |>
  select(iso3, country, year, variable, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value)

write_csv(
  wgi_api_2024,
  file.path(data_dir, "wgi_api_2024.csv"),
  na = ""
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10

oecd_components <- oecd_total |>
  select(
    year,
    bilateral_public_usd_billion,
    multilateral_public_attributed_usd_billion,
    export_credits_usd_billion,
    private_mobilised_usd_billion
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -year,
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "funding"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    component = component |>
      str_remove("_usd_billion$") |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_sentence()
  )

oecd_components |> 
  filter(year >= 2016) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = year, y = funding, 
        color = component )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2016:2024) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(suffix = "B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Components of climate finance provided and mobilised",
    subtitle = "Developed-country finance for developing countries, 2016-2024",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Current USD billions",
    color = NULL,
    caption = "Source: OECD (2026). Components differ in accounting basis."
  ) +
  theme_ipsum(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 14, grid = "Y") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
developing_income_groups <- c(
  "Low income",
  "Lower middle income",
  "Upper middle income"
)

paper_analysis <- paper_projects |>
  filter(
    income_group_at_source %in% developing_income_groups,
    !is.na(income_group_at_source)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    allocated_positive_usd = pmax(project_contribution_usd, 0),
    adjustment_negative_usd = pmin(project_contribution_usd, 0)
  )

paper_analysis |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    projects = n_distinct(project_id),
    countries = n_distinct(recipient_iso3),
    sectors = n_distinct(sector),
    negative_rows = sum(project_contribution_usd < 0)
  )
```

```{r}

paper_analysis |> 
  distinct(sector) |> 
  nrow()

sector_summary <- paper_analysis |>
  filter(sector != "Cross-cutting") |> 
  group_by(sector) |>
  summarise(
    projects = n_distinct(project_id),
    positive_usd_billion = sum(allocated_positive_usd) / 1e9,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(positive_usd_billion, n = 10) |>
  arrange(-positive_usd_billion)

sector_summary |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = positive_usd_billion, 
        y = fct_reorder(sector, positive_usd_billion), 
        fill = positive_usd_billion)
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, show.legend = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_dollar(suffix = "B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Largest sectors in the assembled project archive",
    subtitle = "Low- and middle-income recipient rows, 2011-2019",
    x = "Positive allocations, current USD billions",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Choe and Ore-Monago project archive. This is not a global total."
  ) +
  theme_ipsum(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 14, grid = "X")
```

```{r}
wb_2024 <- world_bank |>
  filter(
    year == 2024,
    income_code_current %in% c("LIC", "LMC", "UMC")
  ) |>
  select(
    iso3,
    country,
    region,
    income_group_current,
    population,
    voice_accountability,
    political_stability,
    government_effectiveness,
    regulatory_quality,
    rule_of_law,
    rule_of_law_lower,
    rule_of_law_upper,
    control_of_corruption
  )

rio_2024 <- rio_recipient |>
  filter(year == 2024) |>
  select(
    recipient_iso3,
    adaptation_total_usd_millions,
    mitigation_total_usd_millions
  )

current <- wb_2024 |>
  left_join(
    rio_2024,
    by = c("iso3" = "recipient_iso3"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    rio_recorded = !is.na(iso3),
    
    across(
      c(adaptation_total_usd_millions, mitigation_total_usd_millions),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
    ),
    
    mitigation_usd_per_person =
      mitigation_total_usd_millions * 1e6 / population
  )

current |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    unique_iso3 = n_distinct(iso3),
    rio_records = sum(rio_recorded),
    missing_rule_of_law = sum(is.na(rule_of_law))
  )
```

```{r}
uncertainty_data <- wb_2024 |>
  filter(
    rule_of_law > 0,
    !is.na(rule_of_law),
    !is.na(rule_of_law_lower),
    !is.na(rule_of_law_upper)
  ) |>
  slice_max(rule_of_law, n = 10) |>
  mutate(country = fct_reorder(country, rule_of_law))

uncertainty_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = rule_of_law, 
             y = country)) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = rule_of_law_lower, 
        xmax = rule_of_law_upper),
    height = 0.15,
    color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = rule_of_law), size = 3) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 100), option = "D", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Rule of Law estimates include uncertainty",
    subtitle = "Ten largest mitigation-marked ODA recipients in the 2024 sample",
    x = "Rule of Law score and 90% interval",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: World Bank WGI, 2025 revision."
  ) +
  theme_ipsum(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 14, grid = "X")
```

```{r}

selected_iso3 <- c("AFG", "JOR",
                   "GTM", "MEX", "BRA",
                   "PRK", "CHN", 
                   "COD", "COG")

governance_profile <- wb_2024 |>
  filter(iso3 %in% selected_iso3) |>
  select(
    country,
    voice_accountability,
    political_stability,
    government_effectiveness,
    regulatory_quality,
    rule_of_law,
    control_of_corruption
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -country,
    names_to = "governance",
    values_to = "score"
  ) #  |>
  # mutate(
  #   dimension = str_replace_all(___, "_", " ") |>
  #     str_to_title()
  # )

governance_profile |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = governance, y = country, 
             fill = score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = number(score, accuracy = 1)), size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 100), option = "C") +
  labs(
    title = "Governance profiles differ across dimensions",
    subtitle = "Selected low- and middle-income economies, 2024",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Score",
    caption = "Source: World Bank WGI, 2025 revision."
  ) +
  theme_ipsum(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 14, grid = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
world_sf <- world_polygons |>
```
```{r}
  arrange(piece, vertex_order) |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326
  ) |>
  group_by(iso3, country, continent, piece) |>
  summarise(do_union = FALSE, .groups = "drop") |>
  st_cast("POLYGON")

map_values <- world_bank |>
  filter(year == 2024) |>
  select(iso3, rule_of_law)

world_map <- world_sf |>
  left_join(map_values, by = "iso3")

ggplot(world_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = rule_of_law),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.08
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=eqearth", datum = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    na.value = "grey88",
    option = "C"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Rule of Law scores around the world",
    subtitle = "Latest common WGI year in the course snapshot, 2024",
    fill = "Score",
    caption = "Sources: World Bank WGI and Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 0 boundaries. Equal Earth projection."
  ) +
  theme_ipsum(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 14, grid = FALSE) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```
